Receive Grain Bid Offers by Text
Live cash bids, texted straight to you.
The DeLong Co. sends real-time cash bids for corn, soybeans, wheat, and specialty crops, with the option to pick up at your farm or deliver to one of our locations. No more phone tag.
How it works:
Fill out the form below with your phone number and what you grow.
When we have an offer that fits, we’ll text you the price and pickup window.
Reply YES, NO, or with a counter-price. Reply STOP anytime to unsubscribe.
Message frequency varies, typically 1 to 4 messages per month during active harvest and marketing windows. Msg & data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel.
For our full privacy practices, see privacy.delongcompany.com.
Questions? Call 800-356-0784.
